title: Haier Heat Pump Tumble Dryer Corrective Action Programme
hazard: The products present a risk of fire as it is possible for an internal short circuit to occur within the tumble dryer during normal use. This can cause the tumble dryer to ignite, causing a fire. The products do not meet the requirements of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016.
body: Summary This page collates information on Haier Heat Pump Tumble Dryers identified as presenting a serious risk of fire. A Product Safety Report page has been produced for each product, which provides further information on the affected models and product identifiers, the risks presented by the product, and the corrective action taken. Read the Product Safety Reports: Baumatic Candy Caple Haier Hoover Iberna Lamona Montpellier Hazard The products present a risk of fire as it is possible for an internal short circuit to occur within the tumble dryer during normal use. This can cause the tumble dryer to ignite, causing a fire. The products do not meet the requirements of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016. Corrective Action The UK manufacturers have initiated a modification programme for products in scope of the safety issue. The companies will visit every home containing affected tumble dryers and make them safe. OPSS is urging all affected members of the public, including those unsure whether they are impacted or not, to check the model links and contact the manufacturer. Should your model be included, or if you are unsure of your tumble dryer model, please contact 0808 178 0516 (Mon-Fri 9 am–5 pm, Sat 10 am–4 pm). Alternatively, go to Product Safety - Haier Europe . Additional information and resources Read the OPSS news story: ‘Urgent safety check for 85,000 tumble dryers’

title: Product Recall: 1.5 Litre Spare Air 300 Kit with Dial Gauge (2608-0027)
type_row: Personal protective equipment (PPE) - Environmental Respiratory Protection - Non Powered
hazard: The product presents a serious risk of drowning as it failed depth testing and does not meet the requirements of BS EN 250:2014. The maximum depth reached by the apparatus without exceeding the requirements was 5 metres, not the 50m required. If the product is used in depths beyond 5 metres, it may stop operating. The product does not meet the requirements of the Regulation (EU) 2016/425 on Personal Protective Equipment.
body: Summary Product: 1.5 Litre Spare Air 300 Kit with Dial Gauge Hazard: The product presents a serious risk of drowning as it failed depth testing and may stop operating at depths beyond 5 metres. Corrective action: The distributor, Mike’s Dive Store, has recalled the product from end users. Product information Type Personal protective equipment (PPE) - Environmental Respiratory Protection - Non Powered Name on Packaging Spare Air 300 package with dial gauge includes 973, 961 & 910 S Model 300PK-CEDG Serial Number 284003 Product Description Black diving cylinder with fluorescent yellow and black branding. Product Report and Image Link to Product Image and PDF Hazard The product presents a serious risk of drowning as it failed depth testing and does not meet the requirements of BS EN 250:2014. The maximum depth reached by the apparatus without exceeding the requirements was 5 metres, not the 50m required. If the product is used in depths beyond 5 metres, it may stop operating. The product does not meet the requirements of the Regulation (EU) 2016/425 on Personal Protective Equipment. title: Product Recall: 32cm Standing Gingerbread Doorstops (2607-0175)
hazard: The products present a risk to health as the sand inside the doorstop may be contaminated with a small quantity of asbestos. Asbestos is a banned substance because it poses a risk to health even at low levels of exposure. The products do not meet the requirements of the General Product Safety Regulations 2005.
body: Summary Product: Snow White 32cm Standing Gingerbread Doorstops Hazard: The products present a risk to health as the sand inside the doorstop may be contaminated with a small quantity of asbestos. Corrective action: The products have been withdrawn from the market and recalled from end users by PMS International. Product information Type Decorative articles/Homeware/Gardenware - Ornaments (Non Powered) Brand Snow White Model 529161 Barcode 5050565905420 Country of Origin China Product Description Novelty doorstops shaped like gingerbread men. Product Report and Image Link to product image and PDF Hazard The products present a risk to health as the sand inside the doorstop may be contaminated with a small quantity of asbestos. Asbestos is a banned substance because it poses a risk to health even at low levels of exposure. The products do not meet the requirements of the General Product Safety Regulations 2005. Corrective action The products have been withdrawn from the market and recalled from end users by PMS International. We recommend owners stop using these products immediately and keep them out of the reach of children. Follow the below instructions for details on disposal and return of the products. For further information, access the PMS International website: https://b2b.pmsinternational.com/product-recall/ or contact productrecall@pmsinternational.com Disposal instructions: Stop using the product immediately. If the product is undamaged, place it in a heavy-duty plastic bag, double tape it securely, label it clearly and store in a secure location out of the reach of children. If the product is damaged and the sand inside is accessible, gather the sand using wet cloths to avoid generating dust. Wear gloves and a mask. Double bag the sand, gloves, mask and cloths, and double tape it securely. Keep children and other people away from areas where the sand has been used until the area has been cleaned. Return the product to store where specified by the retailer for a full refund. If you are unable to return the product to the retailer, follow the steps above and contact your local authority / access their website for guidance on safe disposal of asbestos in your area. For further information, please contact the retailer or visit the GOV.UK page on asbestos in consumer products . Additional information PSD case number: 2607-0175 Lead Authority: Local Authority Trading Standards

title: Product Recall: 3M Versaflo Intrinsically Safe Powered Air Turbo TR802E (2602-0262)

title: Product Recall: Acer ES Series 5 AES015 Electric Scooter (2604-0128)
hazard: The product presents a serious risk of injuries as a screw within the folding mechanism may not have been tightened to the required specification during production and can gradually loosen during normal use. This can lead to a loss of structural support and stability while riding, increasing the risk of the scooter collapsing and the rider losing balance, which may result in injuries. The product does not meet the requirements of the Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008.
body: Summary Product: Acer ES Series 5 AES015 Electric Scooter Hazard: The product presents a risk of injuries as a screw within the folding mechanism may loosen during use, leading to a loss of structural support and stability. Corrective action: The products have been recalled from end users by Acer. Product information Type Hobby/sports equipment - Scooters/Skateboards/Hoverboards (Powered) Brand Acer Model AES015 Country of Origin China Product Description A black, two-wheeled electric scooter. Product Report and Image Link to product image and PDF Hazard The product presents a serious risk of injuries as a screw within the folding mechanism may not have been tightened to the required specification during production and can gradually loosen during normal use. This can lead to a loss of structural support and stability while riding, increasing the risk of the scooter collapsing and the rider losing balance, which may result in injuries. The product does not meet the requirements of the Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008. Corrective action The product has been recalled from end users. Affected consumers should stop using the product and complete the required maintenance to tighten the screw at home. Acer have prepared a step-by-step video demonstrating which screw to inspect and how to tighten it correctly which can be found here: AES015 - Tightening the Front Tube Screw . For further details, please access the Acer recall notice here: https://www.acer.com/gb-en/support/alerts-recalls/recall-aes015 or contact the Acer support centre on 0371 760 1000. Additional information PSD case number: 2604-0128 Lead Authority: Local Authority Trading Standards

title: Product Recall: Bull and Cygnus Fire Alarm Detection System (FADS) (2607-0120)
batch: NCU serial numbers ranging from XAB.2410.01.0001/17518/06.00 to XAB.2410.01.0528/17518/06.00
type_row: Home Safety/Fire Prevention – Public Fire Alarms
hazard: A manufacturing defect in the network control unit (NCU) may cause a loss of communication between devices within the fire alarm system and the control and indicating equipment (CIE). During an outage, the system may fail to process or respond to alarm inputs. This could result in delayed fire detection or alarm activation, increasing the risk of injury or loss of life in the event of a fire. Affected products do not meet the requirements of Regulation 305/2011 as it applies in GB. The defect is confined to a single batch of NCUs (batch reference 2410). Not all units in the batch are affected. Any loss of communication is indicated on the fire alarm panel via visual and audible fault indicators, meaning an outage is readily identifiable. The majority of outages are of short duration and self-correcting without user intervention.
body: Summary Product: Bull and Cygnus Fire Alarm Detection System (FADS) Hazard: During a loss of communication in the system, there may be delayed fire detection and alarm activation in the case of a fire, increasing the risk of injury or loss of life. Corrective action: Affected products have been withdrawn from the market, and Bull Products and Cygnus Group have commenced a replacement programme to replace all affected units. Product information Type Home Safety/Fire Prevention – Public Fire Alarms Brand ‘Bull’ and ‘Cygnus’ Batch Reference NCU serial numbers ranging from XAB.2410.01.0001/17518/06.00 to XAB.2410.01.0528/17518/06.00 Country of Origin United Kingdom Product Description Affected products are wireless FADS manufactured by Bull Products and Cygnus Group, incorporating network control units (NCUs) which manage communication between the devices in the system and the Control and indicating equipment (CIE). The issue is confined to a single batch of NCUs with serial numbers ranging from XAB.2410.01.0001/17518/06.00 to XAB.2410.01.0528/17518/06.00. Product Report and Image Link to product image and PDF Affected Models Model Number Description Serial Number Pre-Fix YYMM Range containing all affected 2410 batch* Company Brand Marking SN.CIE20.A SmartNet Pro Control Panel, 64 zone, 868 MHz – with zone LEDs CSC 2506 - 2604 Cygnus SmartNet Pro UKCA/CE SN.CIE30.A SmartNet Pro Control Panel, 96 zone, 868 MHz – with zone LEDs CSD 2503 - 2603 Cygnus SmartNet Pro UKCA/CE S1.CIE10.A SmartNet 100 Control Panel, 32 zone, 868 MHz – with zone LEDs C1B 2506 - 2604 Cygnus SmartNet 100 UKCA/CE CN.CIE10.2 SiteNet Control Panel, 32 zone, 868 MHz – with zone LEDs CCB 2507 - 2601 Bull SiteNet UKCA/CE CN.CIE00.2 SiteNet Control Panel, 16 zone, 868 MHz – with zone LEDs CCA 2507 - 2604 Bull SiteNet UKCA/CE Hazard A manufacturing defect in the network control unit (NCU) may cause a loss of communication between devices within the fire alarm system and the control and indicating equipment (CIE). During an outage, the system may fail to process or respond to alarm inputs. This could result in delayed fire detection or alarm activation, increasing the risk of injury or loss of life in the event of a fire. Affected products do not meet the requirements of Regulation 305/2011 as it applies in GB. The defect is confined to a single batch of NCUs (batch reference 2410). Not all units in the batch are affected. Any loss of communication is indicated on the fire alarm panel via visual and audible fault indicators, meaning an outage is readily identifiable. The majority of outages are of short duration and self-correcting without user intervention. Corrective action Affected products have been withdrawn from the market. All remaining stock from the affected batch has been quarantined. Bull Products and Cygnus Group have commenced a phased replacement programme to replace all affected NCUs, including units that have not exhibited failures. Affected customers who have purchased this product have been contacted by Bull Products and Cygnus Group with further information. Responsible persons, fire risk assessors and building managers are advised to consider, based on the information provided, whether any temporary measures are necessary while remediation is completed. Enhanced end-of-line testing has been introduced and all future production utilises a redesigned NCU board to prevent recurrence. Additional information PSD notification number: 2607-0120 Notified by: Local Authority Trading Standards

title: Product Recall: Cambridge Audio Ceiling Speaker Fire Hood (2609-0010)
hazard: The product presents a risk of fire as it may not perform as intended in limiting the spread of fire through a ceiling opening. It has been identified that the stitching used in the product is not fire resistant and may fail under developed fire conditions after approximately six minutes. Failure of the stitching could compromise the product’s ability to resist the passage of fire, allowing fire and hot gases to spread to adjacent areas and increasing the risk of injury to occupants in the event of a fire. The product has not been marketed as providing a specific fire resistance rating. The product does not meet the requirements of the General Product Safety Regulations 2005.

title: Product Recall: Fidlock Hermetic Dry Bag (2609-0075)
type_row: Hobby/sports equipment - Swimming/Surfing/Diving Sports Equipment - Replacement Parts/Accessories
hazard: Products from lot number 2409140930201 have a manufacturing defect affecting the adhesive bond between the closure strips and the bag film. As a result, the closure strips may detach partially or completely during use, causing the product to lose its intended function and potentially releasing the enclosed magnets. The product does not meet the requirements of the General Product Safety Regulations 2005.

Product information Type Hobby/sports equipment – Arts/Crafts/Needlework Sand Supplies Brand Galt Sales period 2024 to April 2026 Barcode 5011979623997 Item Number 1005476 Country of Origin China Product Description Nature Craft kit packaged in a green cardboard box with various crafting components including 25g yellow sand, wooden pieces, foam pieces, paints, paintbrush, string and white glue. Product Report and Image Link to product image and PDF Hazard The product presents a risk to health as the yellow sand included may be contaminated with a small quantity of asbestos. Asbestos is a banned substance because it poses a risk to health even at low levels of exposure. The product does not meet the requirements of the Toys (Safety) Regulations 2011. Corrective action The product has been recalled from end users by James Galt and Company Limited. We recommend owners stop using this product immediately and keep it out of the reach of children. Follow the below instructions for details on disposal and return of the product. Disposal instructions Stop using the product immediately. If the sand is still in its packaging, place in a heavy-duty plastic bag, double tape it securely, label it clearly and store in a secure location out of the reach of children. If the sand has been used, clean up sites where the product was used using wet cloths to avoid generating dust. Wear gloves and a mask. Double bag the sand, gloves, mask and cloths. Keep children and other people away from areas where the sand has been used until the area has been cleaned. Return the product to the place of purchase for a full refund. If you are unable to return the product to your place of purchase, follow the steps above and contact your local authority / access their website for guidance on safe disposal of asbestos in your area. For further information, please contact the place of purchase, or visit the OPSS page on asbestos in consumer products . Additional information PSD case number: 2604-0165 Lead Authority: Local Authority Trading Standards

title: Product Recall: Hidrostan Out/Permaroof (UK) Limited EPDM Facade Membrane (2606-0245)
type_row: Construction Product - EPDM (Ethylene Propylene Diene Monomer) facade membrane
hazard: The product is marketed as Euroclass B, but there is no evidence that it could consistently achieve Euroclass B for reaction to fire performance. The product therefore may not perform with the declared reaction to fire performance required or be suitable for its original desired application. The product does not meet the requirements of EU Construction Products Regulation 305/2011 as they apply in the UK.
body: Summary Product: Hidrostan Out/Permaroof (UK) Limited Ethylene Propylene Diene Monomer (EPDM) Membrane HIDROSTAN OUT, 0.75mm Ethylene Propylene Diene Monomer (EPDM) façade membrane, fire rating Class B, (also referred to as ‘CLASS B FR HIDROSTAN 0,75’ and Permaroof EPDM material) Hazard: The product is marketed as Euroclass B, but there is no evidence that it could consistently achieve Euroclass B for reaction to fire performance. The product therefore may not perform with the declared reaction to fire performance required or be suitable for its original desired application. Corrective action: Permaroof (UK) Limited, the importer) notified the two distributors in the supply chain of the product not meeting its declared performance. Product information Type Construction Product - EPDM (Ethylene Propylene Diene Monomer) facade membrane Brand Hidrostan Out/Permaroof (UK) Limited Product Thickness 0.75mm Country of Origin Spain Product Description EPDM (Ethylene Propylene Diene Monomer) façade membrane, fire classification B, 0,75mm thickness, known as ‘Hidrostan Out’ and ‘Permaroof EPDM material. Affected product were available on the market between 31 October 2024 and 24 September 2025. All batches within the dates specified were affected. Product Report and Image Link to product image and PDF Hazard The product is marketed as Euroclass B, but there is no evidence that it could consistently achieve Euroclass B for reaction to fire performance. The product therefore may not perform with the declared reaction to fire performance required or be suitable for its original desired application. The product does not meet the requirements of EU Construction Products Regulation 305/2011 as they apply in the UK. Corrective action Permaroof (UK) Limited, importer of the EPDM façade membrane, with declared performance of Euroclass B for fire performance, notified the two distributors in its supply chain of the product not meeting its declared fire performance. Distributors Dortech Direct Limited and BuildmasterUK Limited have notified their affected customers directly. Businesses who may have purchased this product and not been contacted by Dortech Direct Limited and BuildmasterUK Limited should contact the distributor directly. The potential impact of lower performance of a product in relation to reaction to fire and building safety will vary on a project-by-project basis and will depend on factors unique to each building. Where already incorporated, building owners should seek advice from their building safety officer, an independent inspector, fire safety officer or a relevant building control authority, as appropriate, and consider reviewing the building’s fire strategy if necessary. Additional information PSD notification number: 2606-0245 Notified by: Office for Product Safety and Standards

title: Product Recall: Hilti (GB) Limited Ventilated Cavity Barriers (CFS-VB) - E60 50 (Sizes 150-350mm) and E120 25 (sizes 175-375mm) (2602-0235)
hazard: Hilti (GB) Limited have identified that, due to a manufacturing fault, the active component of the CFS-VB ventilated cavity barrier might not be properly attached. The staples used to fix the intumescent strip in place to the mineral wool component of the cavity barrier may not be of the required number. This may lead to partial detachment of the intumescent strip in the case of fire, potentially reducing the final fire performance of the cavity barrier.
body: Summary Product: Hilti (GB) Limited Ventilated Cavity Barriers (CFS-VB) - E60 50 (Sizes 150-350mm) and E120 25 (sizes 175-375mm) Hazard: The product has been found not to consistently achieve the declared reaction to fire performance. Corrective action: Hilti (GB) Limited have issued a recall for a limited number of specific product codes and ranges of ventilated cavity barriers. Product information Type Construction Products – Ventilated Cavity Barrier Model (CFS-VB) - E60 50 (Sizes 150-350mm) and E120 25 (sizes 175-375mm) Product Codes 2395739 2395750 2395751 2395754 2395755 2395756 2395757 2395759 2395760 2395761 2395762 2395763 2395764 2395165 2395766 Country of Origin Slovenia Product Description Ventilated cavity barrier comprised of a mineral wool slab, intumescent strip(s) and GF reinforced PE foil. Product Report and Image Link to product image and PDF Hazard Hilti (GB) Limited have identified that, due to a manufacturing fault, the active component of the CFS-VB ventilated cavity barrier might not be properly attached. The staples used to fix the intumescent strip in place to the mineral wool component of the cavity barrier may not be of the required number. This may lead to partial detachment of the intumescent strip in the case of fire, potentially reducing the final fire performance of the cavity barrier. Corrective action Hilti (GB) Limited have issued a recall for a limited number of specific product codes and ranges of ventilated cavity barriers. Affected projects have been notified of the issue directly. body: Summary Product: Multi-Colour Ultra-Fine Quartz Sand sold via Shein. Hazard: The product presents a risk to health as the sand included in the set may be contaminated with a quantity of asbestos. Corrective action: The product has been recalled from end users by Shein. Product information Type Hobby/sports equipment - Arts/Crafts/Needlework Sand Supplies SKU sh251116481135504969 Country of Origin China Product Description Sand for play, texture painting, vase-filling, room decor and art. Product is available in clear bags and in shades yellow, brown, orange and green. Product Report and Image Link to product image and PDF Hazard The product presents a risk to health as the sand may be contaminated with a small quantity of asbestos. Asbestos is a banned substance because it poses a risk to health even at low levels of exposure. The product does not meet the requirements of the General Product Safety Regulations 2005. Corrective action The product has been recalled from end users by Shein. We recommend owners stop using this product immediately and keep it out of the reach of children. Follow the below instructions for details on disposal and return of the product. Disposal instructions: Stop using the product immediately. If the sand is still in its packaging, place in a heavy-duty plastic bag, double tape it securely, label it clearly and store in a secure location out of the reach of children. If the sand has been used, clean up sites where the product was used using wet cloths to avoid generating dust. Wear gloves and a mask. Double bag the sand, gloves, mask and cloths. Keep children and other people away from areas where the sand has been used until the area has been cleaned. Return the product to store where specified by the retailer for a full refund. If you are unable to return the product to the retailer, or the product was purchased via an online marketplace, follow the steps above and contact your local authority / access their website for guidance on safe disposal of asbestos in your area. For further information, please contact the retailer or visit the OPSS page on asbestos in consumer products . Additional information PSD case number: 2602-0265 Lead Authority: Office for Product Safety and Standards

hazard: Due to a manufacturing deviation, some handlebars were produced with insufficient wall thickness, resulting in reduced structural strength. Under normal riding conditions, the handlebar may crack or fracture. The handlebar failure may lead to a sudden loss of control which can then result in falls, collisions and injuries. body: Summary Product: ONOFF S9 Carbon MTB Handlebars Hazard: The product presents a risk of injuries as some handlebars have been produced with insufficient wall thickness, resulting in reduced structural strength. Corrective action: The product has been recalled from end users by Blue Factory Team, as the manufacturer of OnOff bicycle components and the Mondraker brand. Product information Type Hobby/sports equipment - Cycles Parts - Frames/Stems Brand ONOFF Model S9 Country of Origin Taiwan Product Description Black carbon bicycle handlebars used to steer and control the bicycle whilst riding. Product Report and Image Link to product image and PDF Affected products The following bicycle models equipped with the OnOff S9 MTB Carbon Handlebar are affected by this Product Recall: MODEL YEAR MODEL 2024 Neat RR 2025 Neat RR SL 2025 Dune Carbon XR 2025 Foxy Carbon RR 2025 Crafty Carbon RR SL 2025 Crafty Carbon XR 2026 Crafty Carbon XR 2026 Crafty Carbon RR S 2026 Crafty Carbon RR SL 2026 Crafty Unlimited GULF 2026 Crafty Carbon Unlimited 2026 Foxy Carbon RR 2026 Level XR 2026 Raze Carbon RR 2027 Zendit RR S 2027 Zendit RR 2027 Zendit XR Hazard Due to a manufacturing deviation, some handlebars were produced with insufficient wall thickness, resulting in reduced structural strength. Under normal riding conditions, the handlebar may crack or fracture. The handlebar failure may lead to a sudden loss of control which can then result in falls, collisions and injuries. The product does not meet the requirements of the General Product Safety Regulations 2005. Corrective action The product has been recalled from end users by Blue Factory Team, as manufacturer of OnOff bicycle components and the Mondraker brand. If the bike is confirmed as affected, stop using it immediately and contact the place of purchase/Mondraker dealer to arrange a free replacement. title: Product Recall: ORB Funkee Sand Toys (2603-0062)
model: For a full list of product names, SKUs and images please see Annex A in the linked PDF.
hazard: The product presents a risk to health as the sand may be contaminated with a small quantity of asbestos. Asbestos is a banned substance because it poses a risk to health even at low levels of exposure. The product does not meet the requirements of the Toys (Safety) Regulations 2011.
body: Summary Product: ORB Funkee Sand Toys Hazard: The product presents a risk to health as the sand included in the set may be contaminated with a quantity of asbestos. Corrective action: The products have been withdrawn from the market and recalled from end users. Product information Type Toys – Dolls/Soft Toys (Non Powered) Brand ORB Funkee Product Identifiers For a full list of product names, SKUs and images please see Annex A in the linked PDF. Country of Origin Unknown Product Description Range of stretchy sand-filled toys. These toys were sold through The Entertainer, Tesco, Matalan, Hobbycraft and British Garden Centres stores and websites between July 2025 and February 2026. Product Report and Image Link to product image and PDF Hazard The product presents a risk to health as the sand may be contaminated with a small quantity of asbestos. Asbestos is a banned substance because it poses a risk to health even at low levels of exposure. The product does not meet the requirements of the Toys (Safety) Regulations 2011. Corrective action The products have been withdrawn from the market and recalled from end users by The Entertainer, Matalan, Hobbycraft, British Garden Centres and Tesco. We recommend owners stop using this product immediately and keep it out of the reach of children. Follow the below instructions for details on disposal and return of the product. For further information, please access the specific retailer websites below: The Entertainer: https://www.thetoyshop.com/product-safety-notices Matalan: https://www.matalan.co.uk/c/customer-services/product-recall-notice/ Hobbycraft https://www.hobbycraft.co.uk/product-recall.html#orb-funkee British Garden Centres: https://www.britishgardencentres.com/product-recalls/ Tesco: https://www.tesco.com/zones/product-recall Disposal instructions: Stop using the product immediately. If the sand is still in its packaging, place in a heavy-duty plastic bag, double tape it securely, label it clearly and store in a secure location out of the reach of children. If the sand has been used, clean up sites where the product was used using wet cloths to avoid generating dust. Wear gloves and a mask. Double bag the sand, gloves, mask and cloths. Keep children and other people away from areas where the sand has been used until the area has been cleaned. Return the product to store where specified by the retailer for a full refund. If you are unable to return the product to the retailer, follow the steps above and contact your local authority / access their website for guidance on safe disposal of asbestos in your area. For further information, please contact the retailer or visit the OPSS page on asbestos in consumer products . Additional information PSD case number: 2603-0062 Lead Authority: Local Authority Trading Standards

title: Product Recall: Sammic Portable Electric Liquidiser (2608-0199)
hazard: The product presents a risk of electric shock because it is designed as a double‑insulated electrical appliance, meaning that a second protective insulation must prevent user exposure in case the basic insulation fails. The manufacturer has identified that, in certain identification numbers, an external aluminium part accessible to the user may come into contact with the aluminium motor support if the first insulation layer fails. If an internal insulation fault occurred between the motor winding and the motor support, the fault could be transmitted to the accessible aluminium part, potentially exposing the user to electric shock. The product does not meet the requirements of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016.

title: Product Recall: Silentnight Smart Wi-Fi Plug (2602-0174)
hazard: The product presents a serious risk of electric shock because mains plug does meet the dimensional requirements of BS 1363. The socket shutters can get stuck in an open position, allowing a consumer to access the live parts and receive an electric shock. The product does not meet the requirements of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 or the Plugs and Sockets etc. (Safety) Regulations 1994.

title: Product Recall: Squishy Dino and Unicorn Eggs (2601-0369)
model: Squishy Dino Egg & Squishy Unicorn Egg 543435 & 543436
hazard: The products present a serious microbiological and choking risk as they can burst easily during normal use, releasing small parts and an aqueous solution. This solution was found to contain an excess of aerobic microbials. If the user inhales or handles the solution, they could come into contact with these microbials. title: Product Safety Report: Tucson 5m, 6m and 8m Pumps (2510-0040)
type_row: Electrical appliances and equipment – Circulating pumps for heating systems
hazard: The product presents a serious risk of electric shock. The mains cable can be connected to the pump in reverse, allowing the live pin to connect to the earth pin and causing accessible metal parts to become live. The product does not meet the requirements of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016.
body: Summary Product: Tucson 5m, 6m and 8m Pumps Hazard: The product presents a serious risk of electric shock as it is possible to connect the pump in reverse, allowing the live pin to connect to the earth pin. Corrective action: Tucson Pumps are conducting a replacement programme. Product information Type Electrical appliances and equipment – Circulating pumps for heating systems Brand Tucson Affected models RS25/5EAQ, RS25/6EAQ, RS25/6EAQ 130SS, RS25/8EAQ Affected serial numbers S/N D44 02809a (5m models), S/N D32 11233b (6m models), S/N D32 01197c (8m models), S/N C, S/N B, S/N A, S/N 2020, S/N 2019, S/N 2018, S/N 2017, S/N 2016, S/N 2015, S/N 2014, S/N 2013, S/N 2012 Country of Origin China Product Description Circulating pumps manufactured by Tucson Pumps Ltd between 2012 and 2024. Product Report and Image Link to product image and PDF Hazard The product presents a serious risk of electric shock. The mains cable can be connected to the pump in reverse, allowing the live pin to connect to the earth pin and causing accessible metal parts to become live. The product does not meet the requirements of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016. Corrective action An installed pump can remain in operation, but you must take care not to handle affected pumps as there is a serious risk of electrocution. The affected pumps can be identified by the serial number (S/N) on the label affixed to the pump as indicated above. Tucson will arrange for the inspection of installed units of the affected pump models and the installation of an updated electrical connector and adaptor piece on the pump motor. This Product Replacement Programme is free of charge. Installed units should only be replaced by an approved Tucson technician or Tucson service agent. Homeowners in Northern Ireland who have had heating system work completed or who have moved house within the last 14 years should check if their property contains one of the specified pump models. This is an important safety check that requires immediate attention. In April 2026 Tuscon Pumps have notified additional production periods of Tucson circulating pumps that were introduced to Northern Ireland in the latter half of 2012 and continued to be supplied through to 2016. These serial numbers begin 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015 and 2016. For further information, please see the Product Safety Information Notice on TucsonPumps.ie, or email productsafety@tucsonpumps.ie or phone +(44) 800 044 3258. Additional information PSD notification number: 2510-0040 Notified by: Northern Ireland Environmental Health

title: Product Recall: Unbranded Twistlok Carabiners, Rope Pulleys and Swing Swivels (2604-0075)
type_row: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) - Protective Wear Accessories
hazard: The products present a risk of serious injury because: These products are classified as Category III personal protective equipment (PPE). Failure of such equipment may expose users to serious injury or death, particularly when used for protection against risks such as falls from height. There has been one reported instance of mechanical failure involving a carabiner of this type, in which the turn lock sleeve spring failed to engage properly, allowing the gate to open during equipment set up. This creates a risk of unintended detachment during use, which could result in a fall from height. The supplier has been unable to provide a valid declaration of conformity for these products. Furthermore, the EC type examination certificates provided have been confirmed by the named notified body to be counterfeit, as the original certificates were issued to a different manufacturer and expired in 2024. Due to the reported mechanical failure, the use of counterfeit certification, and the absence of evidence of a valid conformity assessment, the products cannot be relied upon to provide the level of protection required for Category III PPE, posing a serious risk to users. The product does not meet the requirements of the Regulation (EU) 2016/425 on Personal Protective Equipment.
body: Summary Product: Unbranded Twistlok Carabiners, Rope Pulleys and Swing Swivels Hazard: The products present a serious risk of injuries as there is insufficient evidence to demonstrate the products will perform as required in a safety critical situation. Corrective action: The products have been withdrawn from the market and recalled by Securit Ropes & Packaging Limited. Product information Type Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) - Protective Wear Accessories Country of Origin China Product Description Twistlok carabiners, rope pulleys, and swing swivels - harness accessories supplied for use with bungee trampoline equipment. Product Report and Image Link to product image and PDF Hazard The products present a risk of serious injury because: These products are classified as Category III personal protective equipment (PPE). Failure of such equipment may expose users to serious injury or death, particularly when used for protection against risks such as falls from height. There has been one reported instance of mechanical failure involving a carabiner of this type, in which the turn lock sleeve spring failed to engage properly, allowing the gate to open during equipment set up. This creates a risk of unintended detachment during use, which could result in a fall from height. The supplier has been unable to provide a valid declaration of conformity for these products. Furthermore, the EC type examination certificates provided have been confirmed by the named notified body to be counterfeit, as the original certificates were issued to a different manufacturer and expired in 2024. Due to the reported mechanical failure, the use of counterfeit certification, and the absence of evidence of a valid conformity assessment, the products cannot be relied upon to provide the level of protection required for Category III PPE, posing a serious risk to users. The product does not meet the requirements of the Regulation (EU) 2016/425 on Personal Protective Equipment. Corrective action The products have been withdrawn from the market and recalled by Securit Ropes & Packaging Limited. The components must not be supplied or used in applications where they form part of a safety critical connection system, including connection systems used for safety harnesses and fall arrest equipment. Suppliers and distributors of similar CE marked components are urged to verify the authenticity of the conformity documentation accompanying those products. Any supplier that has been provided with the EU type examination certificates shown in the photographs attached to this alert should immediately withdraw the affected products from sale and recall all supplied items from their customers. In this case, the certificates accompanying the product were found to be counterfeit, despite referencing a legitimate Notified Body. The Notified Body concerned confirmed that it did not issue the certificates. Suppliers of similar CE marked components should: Verify the authenticity of the certificate directly with the issuing Notified Body where there is any doubt; and Check that the Notified Body/Approved Body named on the certificate is appropriately designated and acting within its scope. To verify the designation and scope of the body, the following resources can be used: For EU Notified Bodies: https://webgate.ec.europa.eu/single-market-compliance-space/notified-bodies For UK Conformity Assessment Bodies: https://find-a-conformity-assessment-body.service.gov.uk/ Additional information PSD notification number: 2604-0075 Notified by: Health and Safety Executive

body: Summary Product: Viessmann Vitorondens 200-T / 222-F Oil Condensing Boiler with Vitoflame 300 Oil Blue Flame Burner Hazard: The product presents a high risk of asphyxiation as testing has indicated that some 2021-2023 boilers may ignite late, causing pressure damage and possible CO leaks. title: Product Recall: White UK Plug Adapters supplied with certain Electric Pumps used for AirTumble Gymnastic Tracks (2604-0213)
hazard: The affected adapters present a serious risk of electric shock and fire as they do not feature any safety shutters, therefore allowing access to live parts. The 3-pin plug does not meet the dimensional requirements of BS 1363 and may not make a secure connection with the mains socket as the plug pins are positioned too close to the edge of the adapter. This increases the risk of accidental contact during insertion or removal, and if the user were to touch a live part, they may receive an electric shock. Additionally, the adapters do not include any fuse which is required to ensure safe operation under fault conditions. In the event of an electrical surge or fault, the plug may overheat and ignite, causing a fire. The affected products do not meet the requirements of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 or the Plugs and Sockets etc. (Safety) Regulations 1994.

Please note that the AirTumble gymnastic track itself is NOT affected. The recall only applies to the plug adapters. hazard: The products present a risk to health as the sand inside the toy may be contaminated with a small quantity of asbestos. body: Summary Product: Wizz Toys 13.5cm Dino Sand Stretchy Racers Hazard: The products present a risk to health as the sand inside the toy may be contaminated with a small quantity of asbestos. Corrective action: The products have been withdrawn from the market and recalled from end users by PMS International. Product information Type Toys – Sensory Toys Brand Wizz Toys Model 543525 Barcode 5050565787590 Country of Origin China Product Description Stretchy toys shaped like dinosaurs on wheels. Product Report and Image Link to product image and PDF Hazard The products present a risk to health as the sand inside the toy may be contaminated with a small quantity of asbestos. Asbestos is a banned substance because it poses a risk to health even at low levels of exposure. The products do not meet the requirements of the Toys (Safety) Regulations 2011. Corrective action The products have been withdrawn from the market and recalled from end users by PMS International. We recommend owners stop using these products immediately and keep them out of the reach of children. Follow the below instructions for details on disposal and return of the products. For further information, access the PMS International website: https://b2b.pmsinternational.com/product-recall/ or contact productrecall@pmsinternational.com Disposal instructions: Stop using the product immediately. If the toy is undamaged, place in a heavy-duty plastic bag, double tape it securely, label it clearly and store in a secure location out of the reach of children. If the toy has been damaged and the sand inside is accessible, clean up sites where the product was used using wet cloths to avoid generating dust. Wear gloves and a mask. Double bag the sand, gloves, mask and cloths. Keep children and other people away from areas where the sand has been used until the area has been cleaned. Return the product to store where specified by the retailer for a full refund. If you are unable to return the product to the retailer, follow the steps above and contact your local authority / access their website for guidance on safe disposal of asbestos in your area. For further information, please contact the retailer or visit the GOV.UK page on asbestos in consumer products . Additional information PSD case number: 2607-0179 Lead Authority: Local Authority Trading Standards

title: Product Recall: Zebra Prescription Printer Power Supply Units (2607-0208)
model: GK420d APxxx, GC4xxx, GK4xxx, GK888xx, GX4xxx, GT8xx, HC100, H/LP/TLP/Rxxxx (282x, 284x, 384x), PS4000, T2xxx, Thermal 284x, ZP4xx, ZP5xx BR1xxx, CN1xxx, J1xxx, P1xxx, SC1xxx, WM1xxx, ZXP Series 1, ZXP Series 3x
type_row: Electrical appliances and equipment - Extension/Power Supply Cords
hazard: The products present a risk of fire occurring at the power lead where it enters the appliance. PSUs that serve as the power source for the above-named models of Zebra printers have been identified as potentially containing an improperly mixed phosphorus compound that is used in the flame retardant resin in the DC power supply connectors. This deficiency in the phosphorus based connector resin, when combined with moisture and humidity over time, can potentially lead to overheating or a fire hazard. The product was placed on the market before the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 came into force and therefore the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 1994 duties apply. The PSU does not comply with the core requirements outlined in Regulation 5 and Schedule 3 of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 1994 specifically related to the general requirement to be “Safe” and for Protection Against Hazards (Non-Electrical) and Resistance to External Influences.
body: Summary Product: Zebra Prescription Printer Power Supply Units Hazard: The products present a risk of fire occurring at the power lead where it enters the appliance. Corrective action: The product was subject to a product recall in 2016. The recall period has been expanded to include PSUs manufactured between October 1, 2006 and December 31, 2012. Product information Type Electrical appliances and equipment - Extension/Power Supply Cords Model GK420d Range of Desktop Printer models that may be affected APxxx, GC4xxx, GK4xxx, GK888xx, GX4xxx, GT8xx, HC100, H/LP/TLP/Rxxxx (282x, 284x, 384x), PS4000, T2xxx, Thermal 284x, ZP4xx, ZP5xx Range of Card Printer models that may be affected BR1xxx, CN1xxx, J1xxx, P1xxx, SC1xxx, WM1xxx, ZXP Series 1, ZXP Series 3x Country of Origin United Kingdom Product Description The product is a power supply unit supplied for a specialised printing device designed for healthcare environments to produce legal, highly legible medical prescriptions, repeat re-order forms, or drug dispensing labels. Power Supply Unit supplied by FSP Group. Product Report and Image Link to product image and PDF Hazard The products present a risk of fire occurring at the power lead where it enters the appliance. PSUs that serve as the power source for the above-named models of Zebra printers have been identified as potentially containing an improperly mixed phosphorus compound that is used in the flame retardant resin in the DC power supply connectors. This deficiency in the phosphorus based connector resin, when combined with moisture and humidity over time, can potentially lead to overheating or a fire hazard. The product was placed on the market before the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 came into force and therefore the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 1994 duties apply. The PSU does not comply with the core requirements outlined in Regulation 5 and Schedule 3 of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 1994 specifically related to the general requirement to be “Safe” and for Protection Against Hazards (Non-Electrical) and Resistance to External Influences. Corrective action The product was subject to a product recall in 2016. The recall period has been expanded to include PSUs manufactured between October 1, 2006 and December 31, 2012. Users are advised to check if their PSU is affected and refer to the manufacturer’s recall page for further information: Power Supply Unit Voluntary Recall - Zebra . Additional information PSD notification number: 2607-0208 Notified by: Health and Safety Executive

title: Product Safety Alert: Baby Self-Feeding Pillows / Prop Feeders (PSA3)
body: Baby Self-Feeding Pillows / Prop Feeders Self-Feeding Pillows/Prop Feeders present a risk of serious harm or death. Risk Description Baby self-feeding pillows are designed to enable babies to bottle feed without the assistance or supervision of a caregiver. This creates a risk of serious harm or death from: Choking on the feed Aspiration pneumonia Background Baby self-feeding pillow products are designed to enable a baby to be positioned on its back and attached to a bottle so that it may self-feed without the assistance of a caregiver holding the bottle and controlling the feed. This is inconsistent with NHS guidance in relation to safe bottle feeding . The General Product Safety Regulations 2005 (GPSR) require all products to be safe in their normal or reasonably foreseeable usage. A baby, which is the intended user of the product, does not have the dexterity or cognitive ability to control the flow of bottle feed, or to know when to stop feeding, or to take action if it gags or chokes or to otherwise signal or raise alarm if something is going wrong. Crucial to this, gagging is characterised by noise and coughing, whereas choking is characterised by silence because of the blockage to the airway. The most common reason for babies to choke on feed is because the liquid is being dispensed faster than it can swallow. The harm in relation to aspiration pneumonia follows a similar sequence of events, but a choking event does not occur. However, the baby does breathe in liquid which goes on to cause an infection resulting in pneumonia. The risks from choking and aspiration pneumonia are entirely related to the design and intended use of the product – these risks cannot be mitigated by instructions. Consumers, local authority trading standards services and businesses are asked to take specific action to cease use or remove these products from the market and dispose of safely, as advised below. Action Consumers Consumers should immediately stop using these products and dispose of them safely. Businesses Must immediately remove these products from the market as they cannot comply with the safety requirements under the General Product Safety Regulations, 2005. Must comply with their obligations under product safety law. Local Authority Trading Standards Should identify and take appropriate action against businesses that sell baby self-feeding pillows as they do not comply with the safety requirements set down in the General Product Safety Regulations, 2005. Additional information and resources Consumer Safety Alert Poster OPSS RIsk Summary OPSS News Story Visit the Office for Product Safety and Standards web pages on Gov.uk for further information and contact details.

title: Product Safety Report: 2-Gang Universal Wall Socket  (2604-0061)
hazard: The product presents a serious risk of electric shock as it is not sufficiently earthed. In the event of a fault, accessible metal parts could become live and shock the user. It also presents a risk of fire because it has inadequate internal construction, including wires soldered directly to live and neutral connections. Over time, this may lead to the product overheating and catching fire. The plug face also does not meet the dimensional requirements of BS 1363, which means plugs may not make a secure connection with the socket. Improvements are also required to product documentation and labelling. The product does not meet the requirements of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 or the Plugs & Sockets (Safety) Regulations 1994.

title: Product Safety Report: 3 in 1 Baby Bedside Bassinet with Wheels (2605-0089)
type_row: Childcare articles and children’s equipment - Baby Cots/Cot Beds/Bassinet
hazard: There is no evidence that the product has been assessed using the relevant UK conformity assessment procedures. Technical documentation demonstrating compliance with BS EN 1130:2019 for the crib and BS EN 16890:2017+A1:2021 for the mattress was not provided, and there is no evidence of adequate production control. The product and mattress lack the required markings, safety warnings and traceability information, including warnings relating to suffocation hazards. In addition, the product is not accompanied by instructions and safety information for safe use in English. title: Product Safety Report: Amdelne Tri-Proof Light (2609-0076)
hazard: The product presents a serious risk of electric shock because it is designed so that multiple light units can be connected together in a “daisy-chain” arrangement using connectors on each end of the fitting. To connect an additional light, a protective cover must be removed, which exposes live and neutral pins at mains voltage. If the connector is left uncovered, or if a connected light or linking cable is removed, users can access live parts and receive an electric shock. The product was also supplied with a counterfeit fuse which may fail to provide adequate protection in fault conditions. The product does not meet the requirements of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 or the Plugs and Sockets etc. (Safety) Regulations 1994.

hazard: The product presents a serious chemical risk as it contains butylphenyl methylpropional, also known as lilial or BMHCA. Butylphenyl methylpropional is not permitted in cosmetic products as it may harm the reproductive system and may cause skin sensitisation. The product does not meet the requirements of Regulation (EC) 1223/2009 (‘The Cosmetics Regulation’).

hazard: The products present a serious chemical risk as they contain excess heavy metals. The earrings contain lead and nickel content that is greater than the maximum permissible limit. The hand chain and bangle contain nickel that is greater than the maximum permissible limit. Nickel is a sensitiser and can cause allergic reactions if present in products that come into direct and prolonged contact with the skin. Exposure to lead may cause a wide range of adverse effects, including damage to the kidneys, the circulatory system, and the developing brain. The unborn child and young children are at greater risk to lead exposure. Further information on the health effects of nickel and lead exposure can be accessed on Gov.uk at the following links: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nickel-properties-incident-management-and-toxicology and https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/lead-properties-incident-management- and-toxicology . The product does not meet the requirements of the REACH Enforcement Regulations 2008.

Improvements are also required to product labelling and markings. The product does not meet the requirements of the Toys (Safety) Regulations 2011.

title: Product Safety Report: DUOTTS Pedelec Electric Bike (2606-0117)
hazard: The product presents a serious risk of fire because it is supplied with a non-compliant Euro-style plug that does not incorporate a fuse and therefore cannot meet the requirements of BS 1363. In the event of a fault or overcurrent, there is no adequate protection, which may lead to overheating and a risk of fire. The product is also supplied with a non-compliant conversion adaptor. The adaptor has a non-solid earth pin, which may result in an unreliable electrical connection. Additionally, improvements are required to the documentation, markings, instruction manual, and declaration of conformity. The product does not meet the requirements of the Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008 or the Plugs and Sockets (Safety) Regulations 1994.

title: Product Safety Report: Easee One EV Charger Backplate BP-AP-1/s01-01 (2604-0019)
type_row: Electrical appliances and equipment - Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment (EVSE)
hazard: The affected units have been fitted with an incorrect three‑phase terminal label. Specifically, the terminal that should be clearly marked as “PME” (Protective Multiple Earthing) is incorrectly labelled as “L3”, which may mislead installers during installation. This incorrect labelling could cause an electrician to connect the PME conductor to the standard PE terminal instead of the dedicated PME terminal, potentially bypassing the charger’s built‑in PEN fault detection and automatic disconnection function required for UK PME installations.
body: Summary Product: Easee One EV Charger Backplate BP-AP-1/s01-01 Hazard: A small quantity of backplates were fitted with incorrect labelling. Corrective action: Modification programme. Product information Type Electrical appliances and equipment - Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment (EVSE) Brand Easee Model BP-AP-1/s01-01 Country of Origin Norway Product Description The Easee One Backplate (BP-AP-1/s01-01) is a wall-mounted wiring base for the Easee One EV charger. It provides the electrical termination interface where the supply cables are connected. Affected units were placed on the UK market during a limited period between late September 2025 and 3 February 2026. Product Report and Image Link to product image and PDF Hazard The affected units have been fitted with an incorrect three‑phase terminal label. Specifically, the terminal that should be clearly marked as “PME” (Protective Multiple Earthing) is incorrectly labelled as “L3”, which may mislead installers during installation. This incorrect labelling could cause an electrician to connect the PME conductor to the standard PE terminal instead of the dedicated PME terminal, potentially bypassing the charger’s built‑in PEN fault detection and automatic disconnection function required for UK PME installations. Corrective action Modification programme. Easee have identified affected products using serial number traceability and installer records. Where a mislabelled unit is confirmed to be incorrectly wired and without external PEN protection, charging is temporarily paused until remediation is completed. Where required, corrective actions include inspection, replacement of the backplate and verification by a qualified electrician. Additional information PSD notification number: 2604-0019 Notified by: Office for Product Safety and Standards

title: Product Safety Report: Eclipse / Embrass Peerless Universal Circulating Pump (2607-0037)
brand: Eclipse (Embrass Peerless for use in heating systems)
type_row: Electrical appliances and equipment – Circulating pumps for heating systems
hazard: The product presents a serious risk of electric shock. The mains cable can be connected to the pump in reverse, allowing the live pin to connect to the earth pin and causing accessible metal parts to become live. The product does not meet the requirements of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016.
body: Summary Product: Eclipse / Embrass Peerless Universal Circulating Pump Hazard: The product presents a serious risk of electric shock. The mains cable can be connected to the pump in reverse, allowing the live pin to connect to the earth pin. Corrective action: Embrass Peerless have launched a replacement programme and are advising consumers who own an affected pump to conduct a visual inspection. Do not touch the pump or its housing. Product information Type Electrical appliances and equipment – Circulating pumps for heating systems Brand Eclipse (Embrass Peerless for use in heating systems) Affected product code 490920 Manufacturer reference CFA 25-50-130 Country of Origin China Product Description Circulating Pumps manufactured by Cacheng Machinery & Electric Company Ltd between 2017 and 2025. Product Report and Image Link to product image and PDF Hazard The product presents a serious risk of electric shock. The mains cable can be connected to the pump in reverse, allowing the live pin to connect to the earth pin and causing accessible metal parts to become live. The product does not meet the requirements of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016. Corrective action An installed pump can remain in operation, but you must take care not to handle affected pumps as there is a serious risk of electrocution. Embrass Peerless have launched a replacement programme and are advising consumers who own an affected pump to conduct a visual inspection. Do not touch the pump or its housing. Visually inspect the mains connection to the pump. If the connection is connected so that the clip is at the bottom and connected and the three plastic lines are at the top and connecting to the “three lines” on the pump housing, then your pump is correctly installed. If the mains connection is connected with the clip to the top, and the three lines on the bottom, your mains electrical connection is not fitted correctly. Immediately take a photograph of the pump in situ and then email to it to technical@embrasspeerless.co.uk . Installed units of the Eclipse Universal Circulating Pump should only be replaced or serviced by an approved, qualified service engineer or installer. For further information, please access: Safety Notice – Eclipse Circulating Pump - Embrass Peerless or contact Embrass Peerless via telephone on 0121 744 3900. Additional information PSD notification number: 2607-0037 Notified by: Office for Product Safety and Standards

title: Product Safety Report: EFI Cretaprint Nozomi 14000 LED Industrial Single Pass Digital Ink Jet Printer (2603-0168)
hazard: The product presents a risk of entrapment because the machinery guarding interlock switches do not meet the performance level of BS EN ISO 60204-1:2018, and the guard interlock can be easily bypassed, allowing the machine to run with the guard open. The machine user could then access moving parts, leading to a risk of entrapment and/or injury. The machine control system also showed no evidence of interlock switch monitoring to detect faults. The product does not meet the requirements of the Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008 (SMSR).
body: Summary Product: EFI Cretaprint Nozomi 14000 LED Industrial Single Pass Digital Ink Jet Printer Hazard: The product presents a risk of entrapment because the machinery guarding interlock switches can be bypassed, allowing the machine to run with the guard open. Corrective action: The product has been withdrawn from the market by EFI Cretaprint. Product information Type Machinery – Printing Machinery Brand EFI Cretaprint Serial Number 202522 Country of Origin Spain Product Description An industrial single pass digital ink printer. Product Report and Image Link to Product Image and PDF Hazard The product presents a risk of entrapment because the machinery guarding interlock switches do not meet the performance level of BS EN ISO 60204-1:2018, and the guard interlock can be easily bypassed, allowing the machine to run with the guard open. The machine user could then access moving parts, leading to a risk of entrapment and/or injury. The machine control system also showed no evidence of interlock switch monitoring to detect faults. title: Product Safety Report: Eisenkolb b.V. / Automatic Roman Blinds Pocket Tape Stitching Machine (2502-0075)
hazard: The moving parts of the machine, namely the insertion beam and the guide beam, are not adequately guarded and no protective devices are provided to prevent a user reaching into the machine during operation, leading to a risk of injury from contact with the moving parts and/or entrapment between the moving parts and other fixed structures. In addition, as this is a CNC machine, there is the potential for the machine to start or move in an unintended or unexpected manner. The product does not meet the requirements of the Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008.
body: Summary Product: Eisenkolb b.V. / Automatic Roman Blinds Pocket Tape Stitching Machine Hazard: The product presents a risk of entrapment beacuse the insertion beam and guide beam are inadequately guarded. Corrective action: The manufacturer has confirmed that an infrared light beam and fixed guarding will be provided for existing machines, and fitted by routine to new machines. Product information Type Machinery – Notching Machine Manufacturer Eisenkolb B.V. Model Number ABS-2400 Country of Origin The Netherlands Product Description The machine is used for the manufacture of roman blinds and is designed to unwind pocket tape from a roll and to stitch it in strips onto curtain fabric. Product Report and Image Link to product image and PDF Hazard The moving parts of the machine, namely the insertion beam and the guide beam, are not adequately guarded and no protective devices are provided to prevent a user reaching into the machine during operation, leading to a risk of injury from contact with the moving parts and/or entrapment between the moving parts and other fixed structures. In addition, as this is a CNC machine, there is the potential for the machine to start or move in an unintended or unexpected manner. The product does not meet the requirements of the Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008. Corrective action The manufacturer has confirmed it will take the following corrective action: providing a protective device (an infrared light beam above and below the guide beam, and an interlock), such that hazardous movement ceases when operator presence is detected at the guide beam; providing fixed guarding which closes off potential shear/entrapment points near the path of the sewing machine. The manufacturer has confirmed that the corrective measures will be available on new machines, as well as a retrofit for existing machines already on the market. Owners are advised to contact their supplier for advice with regards to the retrofit of the machines. Until the corrective action has been taken, HSE has instructed the manufacturer, Eisenkolb B.V., to cease supply of any further machines on the GB market. Additional information PSD notification number: 2502-0075 Notified by: Health & Safety Executive

title: Product Safety Report: Electric Bike, V20 PRO (2510-0139)
hazard: The product presents a serious risk of fire because the electric bike and its components have not been assessed using the relevant UK conformity assessment procedures and there is no technical documentation or evidence of production control. There is also a risk of foreseeable misuse due to the lack of warnings and instructions on the product, including those relating to the use of PPE. The product was also provided with a plug that does not conform to BS 1363 because it has no fuse link. A fuse link is required to ensure the safe operation of the product under fault conditions, and it’s absence could lead to the plug overheating and/or exploding. The product does not meet the requirements of the Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008 or the Plugs and Sockets etc (Safety) Regulations 1994.

title: Product Safety Report: Encrypted Fireworks Ltd Handheld 60-Second and 90-Second Smoke Flares (2604-0060)
model: Various colours including Gender Reveal and Colour Changing varieties.
hazard: The product presents a risk of fire and explosion as it contains both Potassium Chlorate and Sulphur. These types of mixtures can be particularly susceptible to initiation by impact and friction and can spontaneously combust. The potential hazard from these items is increased if the articles are wetted or are dampened and allowed to dry. These items should also be isolated from other explosive or flammable goods. The safety warning on the article states that if the device fails to function, it should be immersed in water and disposed of safely. If this advice is followed, then it is essential that the items remain wetted and are not allowed to dry to prevent increasing the combustion of the items. Such pyrotechnic compositions are prohibited to import, manufacture or store within the UK without approval by the Health and Safety Executive (HSE). These products are prohibited under Regulation 29 of the Explosives Regulations 2014.

title: Product Safety Report: GARVEE Buoyancy Aid (2609-0066)
hazard: The product presents a serious risk of drowning as it is marketed and packaged as a “life jacket”, despite being identified within the product documentation and markings as a 50N buoyancy aid. A buoyancy aid does not provide the same level of protection as a life jacket and requires active participation from the wearer to remain afloat, whereas a life jacket is designed to provide face-up flotation without user intervention. The misleading description may cause consumers to overestimate the level of protection offered and use the product in circumstances for which it is not suitable, increasing the risk of drowning. Improvements are also required to product labelling and marking. The product does not meet the requirements of Regulation 2016/425 or the Personal Protective Equipment (Enforcement) Regulations 2018.

The product does not meet the requirements of the Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008.
body: Summary Product: Kaak Dough Driem Line Hazard: The product presents a high risk of entrapment as the fixed guard can be easily bypassed. Corrective action: The manufacturer has deveoped an anti-tampering cover that can only be removed with specific tooling, which is being retrofitted to machines already supplied in GB. Product information Type Machinery - Baking Machinery Brand Kaak Dough Technology Serial Number 70176J - 80263101 Country of Origin The Netherlands Product Description Machine for forming bread dough into shapes for pre-bake. Product Report and Image Link to product image and PDF Hazard The product presents a risk of entrapment as it was identified that a fixed guard could be easily by-passed and opened without the use of tools. The product does not meet the requirements of the Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008. Corrective action Modification programme. The manufacturer, Kaak Dough Technology B.V, has developed an anti-tampering cover that can only be removed with specific tooling. title: Product Safety Report: Machinery Automation Rotary Single Head Sealing Machine (2604-0065)
type_row: Machinery – Rotary Single Head Sealing Machine
hazard: The product presents a risk of entrapment because: The rotating table creates multiple trapping and entanglement points with fixed parts of the machine. There are no safeguards or protective measures to prevent access to these hazardous areas during operation. Although an emergency stop button is fitted, the machine does not incorporate an emergency stop relay within the control circuitry. This prevents the machine from stopping safely and reliably in an emergency. The main body door is secured only by plastic latches, allowing easy access to live electrical parts while the machine is in use. The product also presents a risk of electric shock and fire because: The main frame and doors are not adequately earthed and could become live in the event of an electrical fault, exposing users to electric shock. The machine is fitted with a 20 amp fuse in a standard 3‑pin plug, which exceeds the rated capacity of UK socket outlets and may lead to overheating or fire. The electrical cable supplying the motor is not adequately supported or secured, increasing the likelihood of damage and exposure of live conductors. The product does not meet the requirements of the Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008.

title: Product Safety Report: Massage Mat, HX-1220 (2602-0056)
hazard: The product presents a serious risk of fire because it is powered by an insufficient adaptor. The plug for the product is too small and the live and neutral pins are too close to the periphery of the plug. The product does not meet the requirements of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 or the Plugs and Sockets etc. (Safety) Regulations 1994.

title: Product Safety Report: Metador Defender Fire Doorsets (2512-0236)
model: Defender Fireshield, Defender Inox, Defender Module X, Defender PASGuard, Defender Soundguard placed on the market between 2nd November 2019 and 30th May 2025. Metador products with these names placed on the market after 30th May 2025 are not affected.
hazard: The doorsets were marketed, labelled and/or listed on a declaration of performance as being suitable for external use (EN 14351-1), and also marketed and/or labelled as providing fire resistance characteristics. However, they had not been manufactured and conformity marked in accordance with the required level of independent oversight and testing for use as external doorsets claiming fire performance (under the harmonised standard EN 16034:2014). This means that these doorsets do not meet the regulatory requirements to declare fire resistance characteristics for use in an external location. The products do not meet the requirements of Regulation 305/2011.
body: Summary Product: Metador Defender Fire Doorsets Hazard: The fire performance of the doorsets cannot be guaranteed when used in an external location. Corrective action: The Office for Product Safety and Standards has required all companies trading as Metador to inform the supply chain, distributors and final consumers (where known) of the risks posed by this product. Product information Type Construction Products - Doorsets Brand Metador Models Defender Fireshield, Defender Inox, Defender Module X, Defender PASGuard, Defender Soundguard placed on the market between 2nd November 2019 and 30th May 2025. Metador products with these names placed on the market after 30th May 2025 are not affected. Country of Origin United Kingdom Product Description Steel doorset for internal or external use with optional fire-rating for internal use only. External in this context means that the doorset is open to the elements on one side. Product Report and Image Link to PDF Hazard The doorsets were marketed, labelled and/or listed on a declaration of performance as being suitable for external use (EN 14351-1), and also marketed and/or labelled as providing fire resistance characteristics. However, they had not been manufactured and conformity marked in accordance with the required level of independent oversight and testing for use as external doorsets claiming fire performance (under the harmonised standard EN 16034:2014). This means that these doorsets do not meet the regulatory requirements to declare fire resistance characteristics for use in an external location. The products do not meet the requirements of Regulation 305/2011. Corrective action The Office for Product Safety and Standards has required all companies trading as Metador to inform the supply chain, distributors and final consumers (where known) of the risks posed by this product. The potential impact of being unable to guarantee the performance of a product in relation to fire resistance and building safety will vary on a project-by-project basis and will depend on factors unique to each building. Building owners should seek advice from their building safety officer, an independent inspector, fire safety officer or a relevant building control authority, as appropriate, and consider reviewing the building’s fire strategy if necessary. Additional information PSD notification number: 2512-0236 Notified by: Office for Product Safety and Standards

The product does not meet the requirements of the General Product Safety Regulations 2005.

hazard: The product presents a high risk of electric shock and fire because it has inadequate insulation between the primary and secondary circuits. Internal examination identified creepage and clearance distances of less than 1.0 mm within the transformer, significantly below the minimum required distances, and the product failed the electric strength test. Poor internal construction was also identified, including inadequately secured wiring and poor soldering, which could result in a short circuit and fire. As a result, users could receive an electric shock from accessible parts or the product could overheat and catch fire. The product does not meet the requirements of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016.

title: Product Safety Report: Tesla Powerwall 2 (2609-0219)
hazard: The product presents a risk of fire as certain battery cells within affected units may develop internal defects over time. An investigation identified that battery cells manufactured by a third party may contain excessive lithium plating, which can lead to cracking of the cell casing. This may result in an internal short circuit and subsequent thermal runaway, increasing the risk of the battery overheating and catching fire. The product does not meet the requirements of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016.
body: Summary Product: Tesla Powerwall 2 Hazard: The product presents a risk of fire as certain battery cells within affected units may develop internal defects over time. Corrective action: Tesla have initiated a replacement programme for affected units. Product information Type Other - Batteries Brand Tesla Model Powerwall 2 Country of Origin United States Product Description AC battery system for residential or light commercial use. Product Report and Image Link to product image and PDF Hazard The product presents a risk of fire as certain battery cells within affected units may develop internal defects over time. An investigation identified that battery cells manufactured by a third party may contain excessive lithium plating, which can lead to cracking of the cell casing. This may result in an internal short circuit and subsequent thermal runaway, increasing the risk of the battery overheating and catching fire. The product does not meet the requirements of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016. Corrective action Tesla has remotely discharged most affected Powerwall 2 units pending replacement. Any remaining affected units are being discharged by Tesla technicians. Customers should ensure their Powerwall 2 remains online and check the Tesla app for a notification confirming whether their unit is affected. If a replacement is required, customers should contact their original Tesla Certified Installer to arrange installation. Affected Powerwall 2 units will be replaced free of charge. If the original installer is unavailable, customers should contact Tesla Support on +44 1628 450630 or visit Tesla Powerwall 2 Replacement Program. Additional information PSD notification numbers: 2609-0219 Notifying Authority: Local Authority Trading Standards

title: Product Safety Report: USB-C 20W Power Adapter XZX-KJ1599 (2601-0119)
hazard: The product presents a high risk of electric shock because the plug does not meet the dimensional requirements of BS 1363. The length of the ISOD pin exceeds the maximum permitted tolerance. The product does not meet the requirements of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 or the Plugs and Sockets (Safety) Regulations 1994.

The front mud guard is also incorrectly positioned, and improvements are required to the product labelling and marking. The product is also sold with a plug that does not meet the dimensional requirements of BS 1363, has no capacity for a fuse and is incompatible with a UK plug socket.
