title: Product Safety Report: Variodyn One Voice Alarm System (2603-0279)
type_row: Home Safety/Fire Prevention - Public Fire Alarms
hazard: The product presents a serious risk of injuries because, if an emergency were to occur, there is a risk the system may produce a sound that is too quiet. The INC has a preset alarm volume, however in some firmware versions, there is a defect that can cause an individual volume setting to apply to the entire system. If the alarm is not heard or heard too late by people in the building, they may be delayed in getting to safety and may be at risk of receiving injuries. The product does not meet the requirements of Regulation (EC) 305/2011.
body: Summary Product: Variodyn One Voice Alarm System Hazard: The product presents a serious risk of injuries as, when activated, the alarm system may produce a sound that is too quiet. Corrective action: The product has been withdrawn from the market. Affected customers have been informed of the safety risk and actions to take, including a firmware update. Product information Type Home Safety/Fire Prevention - Public Fire Alarms Brand Variodyn One Country of Origin China Product Description The VARIODYN ONE is a voice alarm system for buildings. The voice alarm system is used to inform people via loudspeakers – in everyday situations (e.g. announcements) and in emergencies (e.g. evacuation instructions in the event of a fire). It is used in large, publicly accessible buildings (e.g. shopping centres, schools, hotels, so-called “projects”). It is only sold to specialist installers and distributors, not to private households. title: Product Safety Report: Veverra SnugglePhant Sleeping Pillow (2606-0323)
type_row: Childcare articles and children’s equipment - Baby Sleeping Pillows
hazard: The product has been identified as presenting a risk of suffocation when used in a sleep space for babies. Pillows and soft toys are advised not to be placed in the sleep space for babies under the age of one year as their presence increases the risk of overheating and airway obstruction, which have been associated with sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS). OPSS has published a Product Safety Alert for Baby Sleep Pillows, which highlights the risk they may pose to babies: Product Safety Alert (PA8). Further information on safe sleeping for babies can be found on the NHS website at the following link: https://www.nhs.uk/start-for-life/baby/baby-basics/newborn-and-baby-sleeping-advice-for-parents/safe-sleep-advice-for-babies/ The product does not meet the requirements of the General Product Safety Regulations 2005.

title: Product Safety Report: Zoeller Lifting Systems (2603-0140)
model: Including, but not limited to, 2405 (Rotary 3), 2418 (Rotary) and 2301 (Delta)
type_row: Machinery - Rear Mounted Bin Lifting Devices
hazard: When in automatic mode, if a person enters the area under the lifting chair during the upward part of the lifting cycle they could, in specific circumstances, remain undetected by the working area protection device. This is due to a blind zone extending 500mm from the face of the two circular ultrasonic sensors underneath the lifting chair. A person within this blind zone when the downward movement starts may not be detected, resulting in them being struck or crushed by the descending machinery and / or load. Users are reminded that the equipment must be operated in accordance with the operating instructions, user manuals and training provided, and that entry into the working area should be avoided while the machine is in automatic mode. The product does not meet the requirements of the Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008.
body: Summary Product: Zoeller Lifting Systems Hazard: The product presents a high risk of injuries as nearby persons may not be detected when in a ‘blind zone’ when the machinery is in operation. Corrective action: Customers are being warned of the risk and supplied with technical bulletins, updated user guidance and safety information. Product information Type Machinery - Rear Mounted Bin Lifting Devices Brand Zoeller / Zoeller Kirchhoff Gruppe Models Including, but not limited to, 2405 (Rotary 3), 2418 (Rotary) and 2301 (Delta) Variants Examples incorporating a “working area protection device” consisting of two circular ultrasonic sensors underneath each lifting chair only. Manufacturing dates 2017 to present Country of Origin Germany Product Description Rear mounted refuse container lifting devices. Supplied incorporated with various compaction bodies of refuse collection vehicles (RCVs). Product Report and Image Link to product image and PDF Hazard When in automatic mode, if a person enters the area under the lifting chair during the upward part of the lifting cycle they could, in specific circumstances, remain undetected by the working area protection device. This is due to a blind zone extending 500mm from the face of the two circular ultrasonic sensors underneath the lifting chair. A person within this blind zone when the downward movement starts may not be detected, resulting in them being struck or crushed by the descending machinery and / or load. Users are reminded that the equipment must be operated in accordance with the operating instructions, user manuals and training provided, and that entry into the working area should be avoided while the machine is in automatic mode. The product does not meet the requirements of the Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008. Corrective action Warning customers of the risks. The UK supplier, Faun Zoeller (UK) Limited, is issuing a technical bulletin to all known customers supplied with affected machines manufactured within the last eight years. Updated user guidance and safety information will be provided to reinforce safe operating practices and awareness of the working area risks during the lifting cycle. We recommend owners of RCV’s incorporating lifting systems with this type of working area protection contact their supplier for further information if they have not already been contacted. Additional information PSD notification number: 2603-0140 Notified by: Health and Safety Executive
